data: Approximately for which hyperonym degree (N) does the average case of the F1 measure reach its maximum value?

The question asks about the approximate hyperonym degree (N) at which the average case of the F1 measure reaches its maximum value. From the caption, we know that the figure shows the F-1 measure for hyperonymization of orders 1 ≤ N ≤ 12, and there are three classes: GSPO and GDIP. The question specifically refers to the "average case," which implies an overall trend rather than a specific class.

Looking at the graph, we can see that the blue line represents the average case. The blue line shows a general upward trend as N increases, but it peaks around N = 8. After this point, the line starts to decline. Therefore, the approximate hyperonym degree (N) at which the average case of the F1 measure reaches its maximum value is approximately 8.
